title: CORE DataSource
description: Configuration for a data source that feeds data into a CORE pipeline. The connector-specific fields are chosen by 'connectionType' (mqtt | sql); each variant declares exactly the fields the host persists (the connector configuration POJO). Only 'password' is stored ENCRYPTED by the host — every other field is stored as-is. 'element' references the DataStructure describing the payload format by versioned CORE URN.

MqttDataSource.title: MQTT DataSource
MqttDataSource.description: Subscribes to one or more MQTT brokers and topics.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure that describes the payload format.

topics.description: MQTT topic filter(s) to subscribe to. Wildcards (+, #) are supported.

client_id.description: Optional MQTT client ID. Auto-generated if omitted.

qos.description: MQTT Quality of Service level: 0, 1 or 2.

tls.description: TLS settings for the broker connection.

password.description: MQTT password. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.

SqlDataSource.title: SQL DataSource
SqlDataSource.description: Polls a relational database via a JDBC/SQL query.

id.description: Versioned CORE URN of this DataSource.

element.description: Versioned CORE URN of the DataStructure that describes the row format.

driver.description: Database driver, e.g. 'postgres'. Only 'postgres' is wired in the NiFi engine.

dsn.description: Connection URL / data-source name (embedded credentials are stripped).

prefix.description: SQL prefix prepended to the query (not honored by the NiFi engine).

suffix.description: SQL suffix appended to the query (not honored by the NiFi engine).

init_statement.description: SQL executed on connection init (not honored by the NiFi engine).

conn_max_idle_time.description: Maximum idle time per connection, e.g. '10m'.

conn_max_idle.description: Maximum number of idle connections. Default 2.

conn_max_open.description: Maximum number of open connections. 0 = unlimited. Default 0.

password.description: Database login password. Stored ENCRYPTED by the host; null/absent when unset.
